I can feel the mob turning toward us.

"An evil sorcerer started the Profound Silence."
"He pretended to work for us, but it turned out that he was driven by envy for Iberia's prosperity."
"Don't try to stop us, outsiders."
"They came from the sea, just like the sorcerer himself."

As they were protesting, the hungry, harrowed look of villagers came into the Sinners' eyes.

A villager, cradling an empty bundle of cloth.
A child, holding a staff and a hat that was far too large for him.

"... They've all lost a lot."

"And that void in your heart blinds you."

"It makes it unbearable to keep your emotions in check."

This is how they deal with sorrow.

There were no emotions or intent to be found in the great calamity that devoured Iberia whole.

So they sharpen their sorrows into wayward wraths against those who came from the sea, just like the calamity itself.

"Which means... someone needs to direct their anger against the rightful foes."

<Irene?>

"Step back, citizen."

"Even if we were to determine that the Ægir has committed crimes, it falls under the Inquisition's jurisdiction to carry out the consequences."

"If the Ægir is innocent... do understand that your actions cannot be permitted."

It seemed that Irene managed to provoke some thought in the mob as they slowly walked away from the Ægir...

Until they eventually scattered away.

At the center of what appears to be an ark symbolizing the City,

at the center of that brilliant, golden light... must be Mayors.

"Let's take a quick break here."

"Are you alright, Doctor?"

"I just need to take a... quick breather..."

"Fuhu... You should probably work on your cardio, or Miss Amiya might have to piggyback you around."

"Yeah, well... once we get back, I'll start working out like Kal'tsit suggested."

"Hmph. Executive Manager, if it ever comes to it, you may trust me with the piggybacking."

<I'm good.>

Perhaps being in close proximity to Mayors's vision of utopia and the center of the light did something...

Seaborns near us only gave us a passing glance without attacking us.

Something about the way they looked at us felt like... they were concerned about us—the Sinners couldn't help but look away with a funny feeling.

"I feel... sorrow, regret... Maybe these feelings are denials for all those times she spent agonizing over this."

"Can we really bring back Miss Mayors?"

<We'll help her return. That's what we're here to do, after all.>

<Alright, let's rest up for a bit before moving on.>

Behind an old billboard that's seen better days stands a vending machine emblazoned with a half-faded T Corp. logo.

The machine is tall, with dozens of thin clock hands ticking and turning down its cylindrical body; there's a promotional tagline written beneath it.

"Stop borrowing time!"
"Pre-pay with your disposable time, and buy time without delay when in a pinch!"

There's a small slot next to the machine for users to insert their hands.
Wait, underneath the slot—there are warnings written in nigh-illegibly small font.

<Just what the heck does it say?>
"Upon use of this device, with the proviso that the user makes a payment of a sum of temporal resource, the user will be imposed a temporary time shortage open parenthesis for the purposes of this agreement, the "temporary time shortage" mentioned will be predicated on the T Corp. Variable Time Scale; however, any sum of a day or greater will be measured based on the A Corp. Standard Time Scale close parenthesis; received time prepayment will automatically be deposited and amassed within the ancillary accumulation device within the machine and will be prepared for provision to the user upon circumstances in which they make a withdrawal request via undertaking a series of procedures or the fulfillment of refund conditions stipulated in the manual thereof, by summation of the user's total per-day hours and the extrapolated acceleration rate subsidies calculated by a distinct formula; the precise period, order, and limitations in reflecting these changes to the user's account balance is determined by the device's terms of service as described—"

"V-very well. The full extent of this multiloquous writing needn't be recited in full."

"Hang on, ain't this one of them things the Collectors wear on their arms?"

We identified the medium-sized Bongy Plushie in a decent spot to be plucked, and decided to try our luck.

I carefully maneuver the claw over the plushies and grab the medium-sized plushie with utmost care... and somehow, it managed to travel to the chute without dropping midway through the journey. A heavy, metallic clunk echoes from the port. Twice.

"Ooh... Abreast the selected Bongy is a Bongy of smaller dimensions; indeed, the idiom "two birds with one stone" would be most apt here. Not only did the two avians grant us subsistence, it also gave us riches."
<Well, I hear something jingling in there. Coins, maybe?>
"Ya think? Gimme that, Dante!"
"What the hell are you—"
"Gonna cut their bellies right open!"
"Little Sir Bongy! And Littlest Sir Bongy!!!!!"

One of the Sinners cuts open both Bongy plushies' bellies, and coins start spilling out of them.
While we were occupied with counting the coins, the jingle slowly quieted down, and soon, disappeared with the claw machine.

人们的目光转向了我们。

“邪恶的咒术师，引发了大静谧。”
“那家伙假装为了我们尽心尽力，实际上不过是嫉妒伊比利亚的辉煌繁荣罢了。”
“别阻拦我们，外来者。”

手里握着不合身的拐杖与帽子的孩子们。

“……那些人，失去了珍贵之物。”

“失去珍贵之物的人，会变得看不清前方。”

“若不将感情倾吐出来，便会无法承受。”

<艾丽妮？>

“请退后，公民。”

“即使此人有罪，执行也应为审判庭的职责。”

“若此人无罪，你们的行为便更加不可原谅。”

群众听了艾丽妮的话后，露出了苦恼的表情，与阿戈尔人保持着距离……

最终如雾散般消失。

在宛如都市具象化一般的方舟中央。

那耀眼的光芒摇曳之处……梅厄斯大概就在那里。

“……先稍微休息一下再走吧。”

“你没事吧，博士？”
